Subject: MAP kickoff & sequencing questions for MSA/DPA/order form

Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — our stakeholders (security + procurement) want to lock a MAP so we can push the pilot into procurement by mid-October. Two asks to start:

1) Can you share a simple MAP template with proposed milestones (eval, security review, legal review, procurement sign off)?
2) What's Redwood's expected lead time for legal to accept MSA redlines (we have our own set) and turn-around on a DPA review?

We have internal blackout weeks around 10/4–10/8 for end-of-quarter activities; ideally we'd surface any critical dependencies ahead of that.

Samantha

MedAxis Health

Subject: Re: MAP kickoff & sequencing questions for MSA/DPA/order form

Samantha — appreciate the note. I attached a first-pass MAP and a draft close timeline that aligns with your October target.

High-level sequencing we recommend:
- Week 1 (now): MAP kickoff + baseline acceptance criteria (SLA, data residency, retention)
- Weeks 2–3: Security questionnaire + DPA review in parallel (expect 5–10 business days for standard DPA)
- Week 4: Legal redline exchange on MSA (we can accept a single consolidated redline set; Redwood turnaround target is 4 business days for commercial teams, 7 business days for legal redlines depending on scope)
- Weeks 5–6: Procurement review and PO/Order Form finalization — DocuSign flow for order form

Key dependencies to call out: any requested changes to data retention or on-prem routing will push DPA work and may extend the timeline by 1–2 weeks. Also engineering needs a fixed test window (we're proposing 10/18–10/25) to run the pilot integration.

Attached: MedAxis_MAP_v1.xlsx, OrderForm_v0.2.pdf

Next steps / asks:
- Samantha: please confirm a single point of contact for legal redlines and procurement PO owner
- Procurement: confirm blackout weeks noted and any internal review deadlines

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MedAxis_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP template), OrderForm_v0.2.pdf (order form stub)

Subject: Re: MAP kickoff & sequencing questions for MSA/DPA/order form

Samantha / Marissa,

Looping in a few legal sequencing points so we have a shared critical path:

1) Please send a consolidated MSA redline (single file, tracked changes) rather than piecemeal comments — that materially speeds our review.
2) If your redlines include changes to the liability cap, indemnity, or data residency clauses we will need a consult with the security team; that adds ~3–5 business days.
3) DPA: we can provisionally accept a standard DPA template; if you have bespoke audit / SOC language, flag those up-front.
4) Order form: Procurement should confirm whether they need a separate SOW or whether the OrderForm_v0.2.pdf is sufficient. If a SOW is required, schedule for an additional week for internal approvals.

I've attached high-level redlines (MSA_redlines_20270906.docx) that show common items we ask to convert to schedule-language — feel free to use as reference.

Sequencing recommendation (condensed):
- Day 0: consolidated MSA redline received
- Day 1–4: Redwood legal review (short form)
- Day 5–9: negotiation buffer (commercial + legal)
- Day 10–15: procurement PO/SOW and DocuSign

If MedAxis can commit to a single point of contact for redlines and a final procurement approval owner, we can target signature by 10/14, assuming no bespoke data residency asks.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachments: MSA_redlines_20270906.docx

Quick sync from engineering/ops side — timeline constraints and pilot windows:

- Engineering can support a 2-week integration sandbox starting 2027-10-18. We need completed connectivity details and any VPN whitelisting 5 business days prior (target 2027-10-11).
- If MedAxis requires a dedicated VPC/private deployment, add a 3-week provisioning lead time.
- Post-signature go/no-go threshold: pilot must pass acceptance test set in MAP (page 2) by 10/28 to enable production roll the following week.
